description_html:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

We are seeking a Director of National Accounts!

About the Job

The Director of National Accounts plays a key leadership role in driving strategic growth across Access’ high-value national clients and prospects. This person will develop and execute account strategies designed to expand revenue, strengthen client loyalty, and deepen long-term partnerships.

This role is highly focused on proactive business development, cross-market collaboration, and ensuring national account strategies are executed consistently across local teams. The Director will serve as both a strategic partner and relationship leader, representing Access at the highest levels of client engagement.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a national account pipeline exceeding $12.5M annually, driving progress against revenue, new business, and account growth goals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that strengthen year-over-year relationships and expand client share-of-wallet.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders, gathering insights and ensuring proposals and deliverables align with their priorities.

  • Represent Access in the field, supporting local teams and maintaining strong client engagement across markets.

  • Prepare strategic presentations, manage RFP responses, and ensure timely, thoughtful follow-up with clients and prospects.

  • Partner closely with National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless and consistent client experience.

  • Influence teams across markets to execute national strategies effectively, even without direct reporting authority.

  • Use market intelligence and industry trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic account plans.

About Access

Access is a destination management company that designs shared experiences for some of the world’s most recognizable brands. From intimate incentive trips to large-scale meetings, trainings, and sales-driven events, we bring people together through thoughtful design, smart sourcing, and seamless execution. Our work blends imagination with intention. We dream big, then we build it right.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 7+ years of successful sales and account management experience within the DMC, hospitality, or a related industry.

  • Experience leading large, multi-market national or enterprise accounts.

  • Demonstrated ability to generate $3.5M+ in self-generated business annually.

  • Experience navigating complex account relationships, multiple decision makers, and enterprise-level buying processes.

  • Strong financial and business acumen, including pipeline management, forecasting, profitability, and budgeting considerations.

  • Advanced negotiation experience involving MSAs, large-scale program contracts, and complex service agreements.

  • Executive presence and confidence working with senior-level stakeholders across Procurement, Marketing, Sales Leadership, and the C-Suite.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Experience mentoring sellers or contributing to team development and best-practice sharing.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • National Accounts deliver consistent revenue growth while meeting or exceeding defined revenue, new business, and gross profit goals.

  • Strategic account plans lead to deeper client engagement, stronger relationships, and increased share-of-wallet.

  • Clients view Access as a trusted strategic partner, resulting in repeat business, multi-year partnerships, and strong feedback.

  • National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional partners work together seamlessly to deliver consistent service across destinations.

  • Competitive opportunities are supported through strong client engagement, strategic presentations, and timely RFP responses.

  • You represent Access with professionalism and credibility, strengthening our reputation and presence in the marketplace.

Why Access?

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work – 3 years in a row and counting!

  • 55+ years in the industry!

  • Women-owned and women-led

  • Fun, creative, and supportive culture

  • Focus on recognition and employee value – including annual and quarterly awards

  • Paid day off to serve your local community

  • Annual all-company retreat to connect, learn, and have fun together

  • Annual qualifier-based incentive trip for top performers (certain departments eligible)

  • Regional team outings

  • Monthly companywide meetings to connect, learn, and celebrate wins

COMPENSATION

  • Highly competitive total compensation, including strong base salary and quarterly bonuses

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

WORK LIFE BALANCE

  • Flexible schedule opportunities

  • Generous PTO

  • Sick days

  • 9 full holidays

  • 5 half days off prior to holidays to unplug early

  • 2 floating holidays off to be used on holidays of your choice

  • ½ day Fridays in July & August (based on achievement of goals)

HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FAMILY

  • Extensive menu of health plans to choose from

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance program

  • Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Mentorship program

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Developer (Java/Spring Boot) based in France.

Join a fully remote product development team working on modern digital products for ambitious organizations.
You’ll build reliable backend systems, APIs, services, integrations, and database solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
Your work will contribute directly to production features, with ownership extending from implementation through testing and release.
You’ll collaborate closely with frontend, QA, DevOps, product, design, and client-side stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.
The role offers meaningful autonomy while encouraging developers to challenge assumptions, communicate risks, and understand the wider product context.
You’ll work on a project currently expected to run through February 2027, with the opportunity to apply modern engineering practices in a distributed team.
This is an excellent fit for a mid-level backend engineer who values clean code, strong collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning.


Accountabilities

  • Develop clean, maintainable, testable, and efficient backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services for frontend applications and other systems.

  • Develop and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, indexes, migrations, data models, and persistence layers using Hibernate/JPA.

  • Translate product and business requirements into robust backend functionality and well-structured business logic.

  • Develop and maintain microservices within distributed backend architectures.

  • Implement third-party integrations, internal services, and other backend integrations based on project requirements.

  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and correct handling of edge cases.

  • Write and maintain automated tests and collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure appropriate feature coverage.

  • Take ownership of assigned backend features from implementation through testing, release, and delivery.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, product managers, designers, and other backend developers to deliver complete product features.

  • Identify and communicate unclear requirements, technical risks, dependencies, and potential blockers early.

  • Participate in code reviews, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows.

  • Contribute to improving engineering practices, code quality, maintainability, and team processes.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of professional backend development experience.

    • Strong practical knowledge of modern Java development; experience with Java 21 is preferred.

    • Hands-on experience building backend applications and services with Spring Boot.

    • Practical experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM-based persistence.

    • Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query performance.

    • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and consuming RESTful APIs.

    • Practical experience with automated backend testing and a strong understanding of testing as an integral part of software development.

    • Comfortable using Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.

    • Familiarity with microservices and distributed systems.

    • Experience with Domain-Driven Design or Event-Driven Architecture is a plus.

    • Familiarity with AWS or another cloud environment is advantageous, particularly experience with ECS/Fargate.

    • Experience in Fintech, SaaS, HR, Payroll, ERP, AI-enabled products, or complex enterprise platforms is beneficial.

    • Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to manage assigned features independently while knowing when to involve others.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into reliable, well-structured backend solutions.

    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar is a bonus.

    • Fluent professional English is required.

    • Spanish language skills are a significant advantage, particularly for collaboration with LATAM stakeholders.

    • Comfortable working remotely and organizing your schedule around required collaboration windows.

      • Benefits

      • Salary: €3,000 gross per month under a B2B contract.

      • Project duration: Project-focused engagement currently expected to run through February 2027.

      • Fully remote: Work remotely from Europe or LATAM.

      • Flexible schedule: Standard 40-hour workweek with flexibility to organize your working hours around the team’s collaboration needs.

      • Time-zone flexibility: Most working hours should overlap with the 9:00 AM–7:00 PM CET collaboration window.

      • Cross-functional environment: Work closely with backend, frontend, QA, DevOps, product, design, and client teams.

      • Autonomy: Take meaningful ownership of your work, manage responsibilities independently, and influence how solutions are delivered.

      • Modern engineering practices: Work with contemporary backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, microservices, and AI-assisted development tools.

      • Remote collaboration: Join a distributed team with processes and tooling designed to support transparency and effective remote work.

      • Professional growth: Develop your technical and product skills through continuous collaboration, problem-solving, and exposure to diverse digital projects.

      • Collaborative culture: Work in an environment built around clarity, curiosity, growth, craftsmanship, care, and open communication.

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in France.

This is a fully remote opportunity for an AI Engineer focused on building production-ready solutions that address real-world challenges at scale. You will combine strong machine learning fundamentals with hands-on engineering to design, train, optimize, and deploy AI systems. The role offers exposure to diverse AI domains, including LLMs, NLP, computer vision, and other emerging technologies. You will work across data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and MLOps. Success in this position requires both technical depth and the ability to operate independently in a fast-changing environment. You will also have the opportunity to translate complex AI concepts into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders.


Accountabilities:
  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI systems for real-world applications at scale.
  • Build, customize, optimize, and maintain AI models for domain-specific use cases.
  • Develop and maintain data mining, preprocessing, feature engineering, and data-labeling pipelines.
  • Work with large datasets to prepare high-quality training and evaluation data.
  • Apply machine learning techniques across areas such as large language models, natural language processing, computer vision, and other AI domains.
  • Train, evaluate, optimize, and continuously improve machine learning models based on performance results.
  • Design and maintain model deployment and MLOps pipelines to support reliable production environments.
  • Deploy and serve models using cloud platforms and containerized environments.
  • Use Docker, Git, and relevant MLOps tools as part of collaborative software development workflows.
  • Analyze model performance, identify limitations, and implement opportunities for improvement.
  • Communicate technical concepts, findings, and project progress clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • 2–5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning or AI models in production environments.
    • Strong proficiency in Python.
    • Practical experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
    • Experience designing and architecting custom AI or machine learning models.
    • Hands-on knowledge of LLMs, NLP, computer vision, or another relevant AI domain.
    • Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning architectures, optimization techniques, and model evaluation metrics.
    • Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, data mining, and data-labeling pipelines.
    • Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker.
    • Knowledge of cloud platforms and services used for model training and serving, such as AWS Lambda.
    • Experience with Docker and containerized model deployment.
    • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
    • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Curiosity-driven mindset, adaptability, and comfort working in an evolving environment.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary of EUR 4,000.
      • Full-time employment.
      • Fully remote work arrangement.
      • Opportunity to work on real-world AI and machine learning applications at scale.
      • Exposure to LLMs, NLP, computer vision, MLOps, cloud technologies, and production AI systems.
      • Opportunity to work with modern machine learning and software engineering tools and practices.
      • International and remote working environment.

description_html:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we're a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It's faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We're backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and owns product marketing for the Billing product group. You will work across Product, Growth, Revenue Marketing, Sales, Finance, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and Brand to turn customer insight into a clear story, a strong go-to-market plan, and measurable market impact.

Monetisation becomes harder as software businesses grow. Pricing models, subscriptions, payments, invoicing, and revenue operations can become a patchwork that slows launches, creates risk, and pulls teams away from their customers.

You will turn a complex commercial problem into a clear story for the people who buy, build, operate, and grow software businesses. You will own the product-area narrative and execution, while partnering with cross-functional teams on broader company positioning, category strategy, and major commercial decisions.

What you'll do

  • Build customer and market insight through research, customer conversations, usage signals, competitive intelligence, and commercial feedback.

  • Define positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, and the product story for your product group.

  • Lead high-impact launches, commercial initiatives, and change programs from early strategy through readiness, channel activation, adoption, advocacy, and learning.

  • Build focused go-to-market plans across the channels that matter, with clear audiences, owners, trade-offs, and measures.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Support early enough to influence priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer outcomes.

  • Equip Revenue Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and partners with clear stories, talk tracks, proof, and practical guidance.

  • Bring competitive and market insight into product, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market decisions, and identify opportunities to sharpen differentiation.

  • Set objectives and measures for customer adoption, retention, and commercial impact. Make practical recommendations using data and opportunity sizing to highlight the business and customer opportunity.

  • Use AI to improve research, synthesis, analysis, competitive intelligence, workflow automation, and product marketing quality, with strong judgement and verification.

We'd love to hear from you if you are

  • A track record of bringing complex B2B, fintech, payments, billing, infrastructure, or platform products to market.

  • Experience leading high-impact launches, migrations, packaging changes, or commercial initiative with measurable results.

  • Strong customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, storytelling, and commercial judgement.

  • The ability to connect product detail to outcomes such as growth, retention, efficiency, flexibility, and confidence.

  • Comfort working with technical, product, finance, operations, sales, solutions, support, and executive audiences.

  • Range across launches, enablement, adoption, change management, measurement, competitive insight, and customer advocacy.

  • Examples of using AI, agents, or automation to improve speed, quality, or insight.


What good looks like
Within your first year, the Billing team has a sharper product story, a repeatable approach to launches and commercial change, stronger enablement, and a clear view of what is driving customer adoption and business impact. Product and go-to-market partners trust you to bring clarity, make smart trade-offs, and turn insight into action.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle
At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. We're more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you'll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don't match every part of the job ad, especially if you're part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there's anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We're committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let's grow together.

Our Values

Paddle Together - "None of us, is as smart as all of us"

Paddle Simply - "Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple"

Paddle for others - "We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs"

Why you'll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a 'digital-first' company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

description_html:
📍 London Office (Aldgate East, E1) | Hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 days remote (or office if you prefer!)

The opportunity

Goodlord is on a mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re searching for an Senior Sales Manager reporting directly to our Head of Sales to help us achieve it!

You will own the execution engine for our Mid-Market segment (with potential to expand to our enterprise segment), helping letting agencies navigate complex operational environments with our gold-standard platform.

This isn't a passive management role - you'll be an active builder, running disciplined MEDDPICC deal interrogation, coaching reps to win, and stepping in as an executive sponsor on high-stakes deals.

In this role you'll:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives through 1:1s, call reviews, and live deal shadowing to drive consistent target achievement.

  • Run multi-threaded deal interrogations using MEDDPICC to validate champions, uncover risks, map decision-makers, and maintain exact CRM forecasting.

  • Partner with SDR and Demand-Gen leadership on territory strategies, while collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Legal, and CS to streamline deals.

  • Refine GTM playbooks, standardise commercial negotiation frameworks, and lay the operational foundations to expand into Enterprise accounts.

What we need from you:

  • Proven experience managing, coaching, and scaling B2B SaaS Account Executives to hit target in Mid-Market or Enterprise segments.

  • Practical, hands-on expertise using MEDDPICC to dissect deals, spot red flags early, and guide reps through complex buying centres.

  • A builder mindset who loves getting into the weeds of deal strategy, sitting in on calls, and structuring winnable proposals.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving environments while demonstrating strong SaaS metrics, ROI modelling, and contract negotiation skills.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience in PropTech, Real Estate, FinTech, or highly regulated SaaS environments.

  • A track record of transitioning leadership scope from Mid-Market into Enterprise tiers.

 

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: People Operations Lead - 3 month FTC
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Goodlord
description_html:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home

📅 Initial 3 month FTC - potential option for extension or perm.

⏰ 40 hour week ideally although 30-32 hours considered.

🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.


✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities. We bring together leading minds to share the latest trends, challenges and opportunities facing companies, the tactics and tools needed to drive results, and a forum to make meaningful connections.

Our Alliance brand is renowned for its VIP dinners, exclusive breakfasts, and bespoke 1-2-1 meeting packages designed to bridge supply and demand across various verticals. Join our dynamic team and drive sales to new commercial prospects, creating valuable connections and driving business growth.

The Role

You’ll focus on selling sponsorship packages to top-tier B2B brands looking to engage with senior audiences through intimate, content-driven environments. These conversations often serve as the entry point to broader partnership discussions, including full-series or multi-event sponsorships, making this a role with both immediate and strategic impact.

You’ll work closely with our wider event sponsorship team to identify opportunities, open doors, and nurture long-term commercial relationships that span across our community portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

description_html:
Join Neudata - Account Director (New Business)

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

With offices in London, New York, and Shanghai and a team of 100 people, we connect a vast global network of buyers and providers through our market-leading platforms and specialist consulting - and by providing a clear view of the data landscape, we help organisations navigate complexity and find their competitive edge. Joining Neudata really puts you at the heart of the fintech industry, where your work directly influences the data-driven strategies of the world's most sophisticated organisations.

The Role:

We're looking for an Account Director (New Business) to take our Scout and Ranger platforms to data buyers across EMEA and APAC: hedge funds, asset managers, private equity firms and the fast-growing world of AI. This is a pure new business role, and you'll own your territory end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to signing the deal.

You'll be the face of Neudata in front of some of the most sophisticated investors in the market, running story-led demonstrations, guiding hands-on trials alongside our research analysts, and building relationships with the people who decide how their firms use external data. There is real scope to grow the role too, including the potential to manage an SDR or a wider SDR team as the territory develops.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Own a European and Asia-Pacific territory of institutional investor prospects, driving new business through proactive outreach, field trips and lead generation campaigns across email and social

  • Run the full sales cycle: leading discovery and qualification calls, delivering value-based, story-led demonstrations of Scout and Ranger, then negotiating commercial terms and closing in line with quota

  • Manage hands-on platform trials in partnership with our research analysts, aligning technical and business criteria so prospects can see the value for themselves

  • Represent Neudata on stage and on the ground, presenting at our own high-profile events and at external conferences in the UK and overseas

  • Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, from Heads of Data and portfolio managers through to procurement leads

  • Keep your pipeline sharp with rigorous CRM discipline and accurate forecasting, and feed market insight back to our product and research teams to help shape where we go next

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in data, research or information sales, ideally into financial services, with a proven track record of originating and closing complex new logo deals

  • A real understanding of how investment firms buy, particularly asset managers and hedge funds, and of the stakeholders involved along the way

  • Sharp commercial acumen and the confidence to negotiate and close

  • Outstanding presentation and communication skills, in person and online, in front of senior and technical audiences alike

  • Genuine enthusiasm for alternative data, market data and investment research, and curiosity about where the data landscape is heading

  • Experience coaching or managing SDRs is a bonus

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days' annual leave, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year 📅

  • Hybrid and flexible working, including working from anywhere for up to 10 working days per year from a location of your choosing 🌎

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing) ✚

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 👨‍👩‍👧

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST 📈

  • Employee referral bonus of £1,000 per successful new hire you refer 💸

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate) with hybrid working. Frequent travel across Europe, the Middle East and North America is anticipated

  • Salary: Competitive base salary and commission structure

  • Start Date: ASAP

Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. First-stage competency interview

  3. Meetings with key Neudata stakeholders

  4. Final stage interview

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK. Candidates who may require visa sponsorship should discuss this with the hiring manager during the interview process. Further information on Skilled Worker sponsorship can be found here.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system.

This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.

  • Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.

  • Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.

  • Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.

  • Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems.

  • Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors.

  • Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware.

  • Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces.

  • Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.

  • Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing.

  • Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers

  • Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning.



What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems.

  • Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development.

  • Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers.

  • Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills.

  • Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications.

  • Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP.

  • Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces.

  • Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems.

  • Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging.

  • Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies.

  • Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.    Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensor

description_html:
We are looking for a passionate Senior Frontend Engineer who enjoys working with modern web technologies, values clean architecture, and can translate complex requirements into elegant, responsive, and user-friendly solutions. title: Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
description_html:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

    • Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity.

    • Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments.

    • Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness.

    • Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions.

  • Be a Senior Technical Leader

    • Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level.

    • Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers.

    • Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in a relevant field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or comparable).

  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, ideally with several years in autonomous trucking.

  • Outstanding technical depth across the full autonomous driving system: autonomy software (perception, planning, control, end to end planner architectures), autonomy hardware (compute, sensors, user interfaces), base vehicle hardware architecture, and system integration.

  • Proven experience delivering complex systems in regulated environments; defense background is a strong plus but not mandatory.

  • Outstanding technical project and program management skills: roadmapping, critical path management, risk management, and delivery steering of multi-team workstreams.

  • Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs.

  • Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team.

  • Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

description_html:
As a Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems.

You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages.

  • Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines.

  • Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments.

  • Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability.

  • Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved.

  • Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases.

  • Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible.



What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5+ years of experience in software release management, configuration management, or similar roles.

  • Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies.

  • Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems.

description_html:
Dein neues Team:

Du willst verstehen, wie Forderungsverkauf, Partnersteuerung und saubere Prozesskontrollen in der Praxis zusammenspielen? Im Bereich NPL & Partnermanagement verantworten wir die operativen Abläufe rund um den Forderungsverkauf und die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern. Dabei sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere NPL- und Partnerprozesse zuverlässig, datenbasiert und revisionssicher dokumentiert laufen. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest eng mit internen Schnittstellen sowie externen Partnern zusammen.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • Monitoring & IKS: Du unterstützt beim Monitoring laufender NPL- und Partnerprozesse sowie bei monatlichen IKS-Kontrollen und dokumentierst Nachweise nachvollziehbar in unseren internen Systemen.
  • Zahlungsverbuchung & Reporting: Du spielst Zahlungen in unsere interne Inkasso-Software ein, führst Kontrollen und Abgleiche durch und erstellst Zahlungsberichte.
  • Datenchecks & Abgleiche: Du führst vordefinierte SQL-Checks aus, passt diese bei Bedarf minimal an und erstellst Grundgesamtheiten inklusive CSV-Exporten sowie Duplikats-, Schnittmengen- und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Forderungsverkauf & Rückabwicklung: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und operativen Abwicklung von Forderungsverkäufen an Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs), bearbeitest definierte Sonderfälle, begleitest Prozess- und Dateitransfers und dokumentierst Vorgänge sauber im Ticket-System.
  • Partnerabstimmung & Nachverfolgung: Du stimmst Dich mit unserer Partnerbank SWK, den DCAs sowie intern mit IT ab, klärst Rückfragen und hältst offene Punkte konsequent nach.
  • DCA-Statistiken & Präsentation: Du bereitest DCA-Statistiken auf und unterstützt bei deren Vorstellung.
  • Maximale Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid mit einem festen Präsenztag pro Woche in Düsseldorf und ansonsten im Homeoffice innerhalb Deutschlands.


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Studium der BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Daten, Reports oder operativen Abläufen gesammelt, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder eine Ausbildung, und idealerweise bringst Du erste SQL-Kenntnisse mit.
  • Struktur & Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zuverlässig, sorgfältig und strukturiert und übernimmst Aufgaben eigenständig.
  • Datenaffinität: Du hast Freude an Zahlen, Tabellen und Listen und ein gutes Verständnis für Abgleiche und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Tool-Sicherheit: Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel, und findest Dich schnell in neuen Systemen zurecht.
  • Kommunikation: Du bereitest Themen klar und übersichtlich auf und kommunizierst gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnerinnen und Ansprechpartner.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse!
  • Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Homeoffice: Arbeite dort, wo Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst. Ob im Büro oder von zu Hause – Du entscheidest!
  • Flache Hierarchien: Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen.
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events: Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents.
  • Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club: Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten!
  • Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser: Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen.
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel!
Schließe Dich unserem Team an und bewirb Dich noch heute! Vergiss nicht, uns Dein voraussichtliches Ende des Studiums, Deinen gewünschten Stundenlohn sowie Dein nächstmögliches Startdatum mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Deine Bewerbung zu erhalten!

description_html:
Your new team:

Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms.


What you can expect:

  • Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release.
  • Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform.
  • Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences.
  • Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security.
  • Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling.
  • Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing.
  • Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority.
  • Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output.
  • Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans.
  • Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery.
  • Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing.
  • Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent.


Your profile

  • Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale.
  • Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration.
  • Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices.
  • Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start.
  • Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios.
  • Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same.
  • Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions.
  • Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II, Architect track progress, and experience with managed packages, platform events, and Data Loader or ETL.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

Your work will directly improve reliability, speed, and quality across customer facing and operational processes. You will grow your impact through mentoring and by helping define future architecture decisions.

At auxmoney, we’re committed to equal opportunity and diversity. We especially welcome applications from parents, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if you’d like us to use gender-neutral pronouns, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you require more time during the application process.

title: Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d)

description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d), you are responsible for sustainably expanding the structure of the Authorized DocuWare Partner (ADP) network and supporting DocuWare software sales. In this role, you implement the solution selling approach and promote these strategies within the partner network.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Meeting or exceeding sales quotas established during target-setting discussions and by management.
  • Developing business opportunities via the partner channel, including creating and implementing marketing plans and collaborating with other departments to identify new business prospects.
  • Actively supporting our partners with lead qualification and leveraging your own closing skills to help secure partner deals.
  • Conducting sales workshops, training sessions, end-user webinars, and customer presentations to educate partners and close deals.
  • Acquiring new partners and expanding the partner network.
  • Handling monthly administrative tasks (such as CRM updates and report uploads) and communicating the results to management.
  • Demonstrating your sales expertise by identifying opportunities and independently managing them from initial contact and the pre-sales phase through to a successful close.


What you need to succeed

  • You have several years of professional experience in sales - specifically with document management, business, accounting, or ERP software. DocuWare certifications are a plus.
  • You possess strong presentation and communication skills when interacting with customers, sales staff, and various other stakeholders.
  • You have excellent IT skills and the ability to competently demonstrate software functions and their benefits.
  • Your skillset also includes analyzing business processes and identifying tailored solutions.
  • Furthermore, you have excellent verbal and written German skills. A very high level of proficiency in spoken and written English rounds out your profile.
  • A high willingness to travel is required. You also enjoy leading and motivating people.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

Recruiting & Employer Branding Specialist

title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Vicegolf
description_html:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.

You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.

  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.

We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.

title: Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)
