title: Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lightspeedhq
description_html:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by! 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a savvy Senior Analyst, Data Operations & Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you!

Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight.

From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations.

Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Develop a deep understanding of Hospitality’s business processes, systems, customers, and underlying data architecture to provide meaningful analysis and support operational excellence within the Pod.

  • Develop exploratory and reusable data models leveraging diverse data sources, supporting business partners with insightful datasets, reporting, dashboards, and clear analytical recommendations.

  • Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical requirements, approaches, and solutions that address the underlying business need.

  • Be the bridge between the Data Office and the broader Hospitality organization, turning complexity into clarity and ensuring clear communication of assumptions, findings, limitations, and implications.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and data flows, and use analysis to help Hospitality teams make more informed and effective decisions.

  • Monitor and improve data quality by investigating discrepancies at the source, documenting findings, communicating impact, and driving continuous improvement across the relevant teams.

  • Collaborate with the Data Office to establish analytical standards and best practices, improve documentation and definitions, and mentor junior team members.

And a little bit of....

  • Stay up to date with developments, innovations, and trends in data, including state-of-the-art machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).

  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

    Who you are:

  • 4+ years in an analytical role, with strong experience in data operations, business intelligence, reporting, or process optimization.

  • Strong experience translating business stakeholder challenges and needs into technical requirements, analytical approaches, and practical solutions.

  • Excellent SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures and multiple data sources; willingness to learn new tools and data systems.

  • Experience developing data models, datasets, dashboards, and reporting that are accurate, reusable, and accessible to business partners.

  • Experience in Hospitality, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Sales, or another operational business environment will give you a head start.

  • Strong business acumen and a knack for bridging the gap between technical challenges, analytical findings, and business strategy.

  • Enjoy tackling complex problems through meticulous research, structured analysis, critical thinking, and creative but pragmatic solutions.

  • Meticulous with data accuracy and quality, with a keen eye for spotting anomalies, investigating root causes, and understanding the impact of data issues.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex problems, analytical results, and recommendations with clarity and impact.

  • A drive to deliver results, strong organizational skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to drive projects autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, GitHub, and Salesforce is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Segment, Heap type of tools

What’s in it for you:

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services

  • ​​Health and wellness benefit

  • Volunteer day to be able to give back to society!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

description_html:
Über uns & Die Opportunity

Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken?
Lightspeed ist die führende All-in-One-Plattform für Handel und Gastronomie. Nach dem erfolgreichen Launch in allen deutschen Großstädten ist Stuttgart unser nächster Stopp! Als KI-getriebenes Tech-Unternehmen bieten wir dir eines der besten SaaS-Produkte auf dem Markt.

In dieser Rolle bist du nicht einfach nur Angestellter – du bist der "Owner" deines eigenen Gebiets in Stuttgart. Gemeinsam mit einem neuen, dynamischen Team von ca. 3 Personen und einem erfahrenen Manager vor Ort eroberst du den Münchner Gastronomiemarkt. Wir verzichten auf Micromanagement und setzen auf Vertrauen, Freiheit und Ergebnisse.

Deine Mission in Stuttgart

Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet und gewinnst die Top-Locations der Stadt für Lightspeed. Dein Erfolg basiert auf einem modernen, holistischen Vertriebsansatz:

  • Digitaler Rückenwind: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv durch Performance Marketing & qualifizierte Leads.

  • Strategische Partnerschaften: Du baust dir ein lokales Netzwerk und ein starkes Empfehlungsmanagement (Referrals) auf.

  • Gezielte Kaltakquise & Walk-ins: Du bist täglich im Markt präsent, besuchst Restaurants, Cafés sowie Bars und überzeugst die Inhaber direkt vor Ort.

  • Full-Cycle-Verantwortung: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess selbstständig – vom ersten Händedruck über die Produkt-Demo bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Beratender Verkauf: Du verkaufst nicht nur Software, sondern hilfst Gastronomen partnerschaftlich dabei, ihr Business erfolgreicher zu machen.



Wer du bist (Dein Profil)

  • Ein echter Hunter: Du liebst die Herausforderung der Neukundengewinnung, bist extrem selbstmotiviert und brauchst niemanden, der dir ständig über die Schulter schaut.

  • Kommunikationsstark: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (essenziell für den Vertrauensaufbau mit lokalen Inhabern) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

  • Charismatisch & Resistent: Du besitzt ein sicheres Auftreten, starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten und hast kein Problem damit, in ein volles Restaurant zu gehen und ein Gespräch zu starten.

  • Ehrgeizig: Du willst deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt belohnt wird.

  • Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Business Development oder in der Gastronomie ist ein Plus – dein Drive und deine Einstellung zählen für uns jedoch am meisten.



Das Angebot – Warum Lightspeed?

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Ein faires Fixgehalt gepaart mit einer ungedeckelten Provision (uncapped Commission) – mit überdurchschnittlich hohem Verdienstpotenzial für Top-Performer.

  • Regelmäßiger Gehalts-Boost: Eine echte Performance-Kultur, bei der dein Gehalt durch das Erreichen von klaren Umsatzmeilensteinen in schnellen Abständen spürbar steigen kann.

  • Sicherer Start: Wir investieren in dich. Freue dich auf einen erstklassigen Onboarding-Monat sowie eine strukturierte Ramp-up-Phase inklusive garantiertem Bonus in den ersten Monaten.

  • Company Equity: Werde durch unser attraktives Aktienprogramm direkt am Erfolg von Lightspeed beteiligt.

  • Lifestyle & Flexibilität: Profitiere von Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie einem jährlichen Budget für Fitness und Wellness.

  • Team-Power & Kultur: Arbeite in einem großartigen lokalen Team in unserem Münchner HQ und feiere unsere Erfolge bei legendären Events – wie unserem globalen Sales Summit in Kanada.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Zuschuss zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket für Stuttgart sowie professionelle mentale Unterstützung über die Modern Health App.

 

Bewerb dich jetzt!

title: Sales Development Representative
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Onhires
description_html:
Germany | Remote | Full-time | Permanent Employment

Our client is a Swiss technology company developing an AI-powered industrial monitoring solution that combines thermal imaging hardware and software. The technology helps industrial facilities prevent fires, identify equipment issues early, and reduce costly unplanned downtime.

The company is expanding in Germany and is looking for a Sales Development Representative to build outbound pipeline and open conversations with new industrial customers.

This is a phone-first outbound role. You’ll spend much of your time speaking with plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, safety teams, operations leaders, and other decision-makers. Experience in industrial technology, manufacturing, or another B2B environment is a plus, but not required.

What you’ll do

  • Build outbound pipeline through cold calling, supported by email and LinkedIn

  • Research target companies, identify the right contacts, and map accounts

  • Start conversations with industrial prospects and qualify genuine opportunities

  • Understand the prospect’s pain, urgency, and decision-making process before handing opportunities to Account Executives

  • Work attendee lists before trade shows and follow up with prospects afterwards

  • Identify opportunities across additional facilities and sister sites within existing customer groups

  • Keep prospecting activity and pipeline data organized in HubSpot

  • Use modern sales and AI tools to speed up research, preparation, and outreach

  • Help develop the outbound playbook by documenting approaches, messaging, and objections that work

What we’re looking for

  • Strong cold-calling and communication skills

  • A proactive, hunter mentality — comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

  • Experience with outbound prospecting, sales development, inside sales, or another call-heavy role

  • Strong technology literacy and confidence working with CRM, sequencing, prospecting, and AI tools

  • Ability to research accounts and identify relevant stakeholders rather than simply work through contact lists

  • Good qualification skills and a disciplined approach to handing opportunities to Account Executives

  • Resilience, curiosity, coachability, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong organizational skills and CRM discipline

  • Fluent German and strong English

Experience prospecting into industrial technology, manufacturing, wood processing, recycling, paper, fire protection, industrial automation, predictive maintenance, or similar environments would be a strong advantage.

The company is also open to candidates from SaaS or other high-volume outbound environments who can demonstrate strong phone skills and the ability to generate qualified pipeline.

What the company offers

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped variable compensation tied to qualified meetings and pipeline

  • A clear opportunity to progress from SDR into an Account Executive / closing role

  • Direct exposure to company leadership and an experienced commercial team

  • Modern sales stack and extensive use of AI and automation

  • High ownership and the opportunity to help shape the company's outbound sales approach in Germany

  • Flexible remote working model

  • Occasional participation in trade shows, company events, and customer site visits, with business travel covered

Hiring process

  • Introductory interview

  • Deep-dive interview focused on your outbound and prospecting experience

  • Team interview

  • Cold-call role-play based on a real customer scenario

  • Final conversation with company leadership

description_html:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform “Heartbeat” und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Wir bieten Kunden zudem einen "One-Stop-Shop" für den Kauf und die Installation individueller und intelligenter Energie-Systemlösungen, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden weltweit mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif anbieten zu können.

Erfahre über unser Product & Tech Team!

Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission!

Deine Position

Als Energy Operations Team sind wir Teil des Product und Tech Teams von 1KOMMA5°. Wir arbeiten täglich daran, dass unsere digitalen Produkte tausenden Kund:innen weltweit zur Verfügung stehen. Wir wachsen stark und suchen deshalb weitere Verstärkung! Was zählt ist, dass du motiviert bist, die untenstehende Aufgaben anzugehen, Gas (bzw. Strom) zu geben und eine steile Lernkurve suchst.

  • Du unterstützt das Energy Operations Team im Tagesgeschäft bei Projekten wie #DynamicPulse oder #SmartMeterRollout – für eine digitale und vernetzte Energiewelt von morgen
  • Du hilfst, ein echtes Fokusthema von 1KOMMA5°, unseren dynamischen Stromtarif "Dynamic Pulse", zu skalieren
  • Du stimmst dich eigenverantwortlich mit internen (z. B. lokale Installationsbetriebe der 1KOMMA5° Gruppe) sowie externen Stakeholdern (z. B. Netzbetreibern) ab und lernst tagtäglich die "real-life" Umsetzung der Energiewende kennen
  • Du analysierst und optimierst Prozesse
  • Du hast Lust nach Abschluss der Einarbeitung eigenverantwortlich ein Projekt zu übernehmen und - in Begleitung deiner Führungskraft - umzusetzen
  • Du bereitest Präsentationen für relevante Product Owner auf
  • Gemeinsam mit deinem Team wertest du den aktuellen Stand der KPIs aus und leitest Maßnahmen ab

Dein Profil

  • Du kannst uns für mindestens 4 Monate und gerne auch länger (Wunsch: 6 Monate) als Praktikant:in unterstützen
  • Für diese Stelle ist es unerlässlich, dass du dich wohl damit fühlst fließend auf Deutsch zu kommunizieren (mind. C1 Niveau)

  • Du magst datenbasierte Arbeit
  • Du suchst eine steile Lernkurve und bist offen für Feedback - jeder Mensch kann dazulernen, genau dafür wollen wir Raum geben
  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft? Super! Du bist noch Rookie in der Branche? Kein Problem – für uns zählt Motivation und Lernwille!

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt, Berlin &München zu arbeiten, mit flexiblen Home-Office Möglichkeiten
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

Trusted Shops – We build trust. 

Our mission is to make online shopping safer and more reliable by connecting trustworthy online shops with over 40 million European consumers in our Community of Trust. Whether it’s authentic reviews, buyer protection, or legal tech solutions – our tools help brands create transparency, reduce uncertainty, and attract new customers. In short: no more fakes. 

Your Impact:  

As a Senior Sales Manager, you'll put your SaaS, digital marketing, and e-commerce know-how to work where it counts: winning new business and driving real B2B sales results. With a sharp focus on acquiring new customers and a structured approach to the sales cycle, you’ll play a key role in fueling our company’s growth. Engaging with clients across a wide range of industries, you’ll confidently introduce our platform to mid-sized and high growth businesses - helping them unlock their full growth potential. 

Your Mission: Drive Growth. Build Trust. Close Deals. 

  • Understand customer needs by analyzing their business challenges – and use AI-driven insights to present tailored, value-adding solutions. 

  • Own the full new business cycle – from identifying and approaching qualified leads to closing deals and handing over seamlessly to our Account Management team.

  • Manage a strong pipeline of qualified leads and opportunities, ensuring consistent momentum and measurable results. 

  • Pitch our SaaS solutions to mid-sized and high growth businesses across various industry verticals – via video calls, phone, email, or on-site meetings when needed. 

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, partnerships, account management, and customer success to deliver a customer-first experience and help shape a digital world people can trust. 

  • Engage e-commerce decision-makers and build compelling cases for partnering with Trusted Shops.

  • 3+ years of sales experience in the SaaS industry or in selling complex, consultative digital products or software solutions.

  • Proven track record in sales, with experience managing diverse deals and stakeholders across the pipeline – from mid-sized clients to fast-growing enterprises. 

  • Proactive and results-driven mindset – you're motivated by success, learn from setbacks, and continuously strive to improve. 

  • Exceptional communication skills, quick thinking, and a strategic approach to navigating complex sales conversations.

Ralph ist Deutschlands modernste Hausverwaltung. Wir denken WEG von Grund auf neu – mit 10.000 Einheiten deutschlandweit haben wir bewiesen, dass unser Modell skaliert. Wir verbinden unsere eigene AI-Software mit der Expertise erfahrener Profis und einem starken operativen Team, das dir den Rücken frei hält.

Deine Rolle: Strategischer Fokus statt Admin-Chaos

Du arbeitest bei uns strategischer als in klassischen Verwaltungen. Du bist der/die souveräne Ansprechpartner:in für Beiräte, während unsere Struktur dir den administrativen Wahnsinn abnimmt:

  • Support: Ein Customer Success Team beantwortet Tickets und Standard-Anfragen für dich.

  • Technik: Ein Instandhaltungs-Team übernimmt die Handwerker-Koordination.

  • Backoffice: Ein Buchhaltungs-Team hält die Zahlen und Abrechnungen sauber.

  • AI: Unsere Software automatisiert die Dokumentation und das Daily Business.

Deine Mission

  • Beirats-Management: Du pflegst die Beziehungen zu den Beiräten und führst deine Gemeinschaften souverän durch das Jahr.

  • Versammlungsleitung: Du moderierst hybride und digitale Eigentümerversammlungen mit unserer hauseigenen Software.

  • Innovation: Du bist die Schnittstelle zum Produkt-Team und hilfst uns, die Software so zu bauen, dass sie Verwaltern das Leben rettet.

  • Wachstum (Optional): Du hast Lust, neue Kunden zu begeistern? Wir honorieren das mit attraktiven Prämien.


  • Erfahrung: Du bist Profi in der WEG-Verwaltung und kennst die Fallstricke der Branche.

  • Zertifizierung: Du bist „Zertifizierter Verwalter“ (§ 26a WEG) oder hast eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Ownership: Du hast keine Lust mehr auf „Dienst nach Vorschrift“, sondern willst Prozesse aktiv neu denken.

  • Kommunikation: Du trittst sicher auf und überzeugst Beiräte durch Kompetenz und Verbindlichkeit.

Was du bei Ralph bekommst

  • Echte Freiheit: Wir sind "Remote-first". Egal ob Hamburg, Berlin oder ein Coffee-Shop – du arbeitest, von wo du willst.

  • Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem stabilen, VC-finanzierten PropTech mit 10.000 Einheiten im Rücken.

  • Entwicklung: Wir fördern deine Spezialisierung zum Klimaverwalter.

  • Extras: Attraktives Fixum plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und regelmäßige Team-Offsites.

  • Modernes Setup: High-End Hardware (MacBook) und unsere eigene AI-Plattform, die dir den Rücken frei hält.

title: Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at limehome
description_html:
Greif mit uns nach den Sternen!

Zur Unterstützung unseres Finance-Teams bei Limehome suchen wir eine:n motivierte:n Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting (m/w/d). Du unterstützt primär unser Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft und bei den Monatsabschlüssen und bekommst je nach Bedarf darüber hinaus Einblicke in weitere Finance-Themen wie Reporting, FP&A und Prozessautomatisierung. So lernst du eine moderne, tech-getriebene Finanzfunktion in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen von Grund auf kennen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung.

Als ‘Host with heart’ bist du für diese Themen verantwortlich:

  • Du unterstützt das Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft, zum Beispiel in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung (z. B. Rechnungserfassung, Kontenabstimmung, Belegmanagement).

  • Du hilfst bei vorbereitenden Tätigkeiten für die Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse mit.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung von Daten und Auswertungen, z. B. für Reportings oder Ad-hoc Anfragen.

  • Du wirkst an der Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Finance-Prozessen mit – inkl. dem Einsatz von Tools und KI.

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig je nach Bedarf kleinere Projekte und Ad-hoc-Aufgaben über den gesamten Finance-Bereich hinweg.


Was Du brauchst, um mit uns nach den Sternen zu greifen:

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in, idealerweise mit wirtschaftswissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt (z. B. BWL, Finance, Accounting, Wirtschaftsinformatik).

  • Du bringst eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit und arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen.

  • Du hast eine Affinität für Prozesse, Tools und Systeme und Interesse an Automatisierung und KI

  • Du bist proaktiv, lernbereit und übernimmst gerne früh Verantwortung.

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du kannst uns idealerweise für etwa 16-20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen (flexibel in der Prüfungszeit).

Darum wirst du deinen “Aufenthalt” bei uns lieben:

  • Onboarding und Feedback: Wir sorgen mit unserem gut durchdachten Onboarding-Prozess für einen reibungslosen Start. Regelmäßiges Feedback und Peer Reviews unterstützen dich zusätzlich in deiner Weiterentwicklung. 

  • OneTeam: Eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit Team-Stand-ups, regelmäßigen All-Hands-Meetings und Firmenevents (Sommerparty, Wiesn,...).

  • Alles für unsere Limehomies: Bis zu 24 bezahlte Urlaubstage im Jahr, Rabatte bei Urban Sports Club, Unterstützung beim Thema psychische Gesundheit (Nilo.health), Staycations in einem unserer Limehomes und viele weitere Vorteile.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt: Unsere faire Vergütung für Werkstudierende 15€ (Bachelor)/17€ (Master) / unser Praktikantengehalt von 2.550/1800 € ermöglichen dir einen komfortablen Lebensstil

  • Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks: Frisches Obst, gesunde Snacks und Schokolade sind genau wie Kaffee und Softdrinks zur freien Verfügung

Über Limehome:

Limehome ist ein führender, technologiebasierter Hospitality-Betreiber, der funktional gestaltete Designunterkünfte in ganz Europa anbietet. Durch den Einsatz seiner proprietären Technologie ermöglicht Limehome einen reibungslosen und komfortablen Aufenthalt mit einem nahtlosen digitalen Gästeerlebnis für Geschäfts- und Urlaubsreisende. Gegründet im Jahr 2018, beschäftigt Limehome heute über 300 Mitarbeitende und zählt über 10.000 Limehome Apartments und Hotelzimmer in 150 Städten in 13 europäischen Ländern.

title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Alcemy
description_html:
Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity


Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today

alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants.

The role

You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy.

That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning.

It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier.

What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe.

What you'll do

  • Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use
  • Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction
  • Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning
  • Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language
  • Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical
  • Collaborate with the product team on backend work

Requirements

You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count.

Must-haves

  • You've deployed production-grade Python applications
  • You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles
  • You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams
  • You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early
  • You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects
  • Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django
  • PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases
  • Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems


Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you.


How we work

You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy.

Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving.

We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests.

We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here.

Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert or management tracks - and the chance to lead a product area within a couple of years.

Benefits

    • 25 days' vacation - plus an extra day for every 2 years here, and the days between Christmas and New Year off
    • €1,500/year and 3 days/quarter for your own development
    • The Mac of your choice
    • An office in the heart of Berlin Mitte


Our Tech Stack

    • Backend & data: Python throughout - FastAPI (auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI), SQLAlchemy, pydantic, pytest, mypy; pandas, polars, numpy, sklearn; uv for dependencies
    • Infra: PostgreSQL, AWS on Kubernetes managed with Terraform, ArgoWorkflows for scheduled jobs, GitLab for code
    • Frontend: React & Next.js in TypeScript with TailwindCSS; Blueprint.js / Radix UI; TanStack Query or axios; Streamlit for internal tools


Our Hiring Process is fully remote

    1. Intro call with our Recruiter
    2. Meet our Hiring Manager
    3. A take-home task that mirrors the real work you'd be doing
    4. Technical interview (90 min) with two engineers, including 30 min of live coding
    5. Team-fit interview (45 min) with two future teammates


At alcemy, we're building a team as diverse as the industry we're transforming. We welcome applications from everyone and assess every candidate on merit alone - regardless of gender, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or worldview, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We especially encourage people who are underrepresented in tech to apply. If you need any adjustments to take part fully in our hiring process, just let us know and we'll make them.


Note: We don't currently offer visa sponsorship, so you'll need a valid EU work visa.

title: Legal Specialist Tech & Data (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Neon
description_html:
Overview

NEON is a highly specialized business law firm providing advice at the highest level. We embrace shared entrepreneurship, are more than just colleagues, and love what we do. Our teams – including Venture Capital, Private Equity, Litigation, Real Estate, Tax, and Tech & Data – deliver holistic advice and work closely together.
 Our focus is on the legal support of entrepreneurial projects – from investments and transactions to the development of new business models, the structuring of complex commercial arrangements, and the legal enablement of digital innovation.
Our Tech & Data Team advises national and international clients on legal issues relating to data protection, IT law, AI, digital business models and the regulatory requirements of an increasingly digital economy. We help innovative companies navigate complex legal frameworks and enable technological progress through practical legal advice.
Are you looking for a position that allows you to pursue your legal career ambitions while benefiting from predictable working hours and more time for your personal life? 

We offer a great alternative.

To join our team, we are looking for a


Your mission

You are passionate about the intersection of law andtechnology and want to deepen your legal expertise in these areas.  
As a Legal Specialist in our Tech & Data team, you will work on a broad range of matters relating to data protection, IT law, artificial intelligence and digital business models and take ownership of legal tasks to actively contribute to the successful delivery of our client matters. Working closely with a highly specialized team, you will gain insight into some of the most dynamic developments at the intersection of law, technology and business. 
Unlike a traditional Associate role, your focus will not be on transactions. Instead, you will take ownership of clearly defined areas of responsibility and recurring legal matters that allow for a predictable and manageable workload while still offering work on champions league level.


What we offer

  • Flexible working time models (Full-time or Part-time, with adjustable weekly working days), clearly defined working hours to help you plan your life and ensure a steady, predictable workload 
  • Independent but clearly scoped areas of responsibility 
  • Involvement in client work from day one, supported by your team lead
  • A respectful and vibrant company culture (team-lunches, after-work events, many firm activities…)
  • A healthy balance between work, family, and personal life


Your profile

  • You have successfully completed both German State Examinations in Law (at least 18 points in total)
  • A genuine interest in Tech & Data – including data protection, IT and software law – ideally with first practical experience in these fields
  • Curiosity for technology (AI, software contracts, cloud computing, and digital business models) and enthusiasm for solving legal challenges around digital innovation
  • You have a quick mind, can think outside the box and enjoy working in a team
  • Excellent German and strong English skills complete your profile

title: Working Student System Administration (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Helpling
description_html:
YOUR IMPACT - YOUR ROLE

Show us how you rock IT!

You juggle bits and bytes while others are still looking for their coffee cups? Then join our dynamic and modern company, where innovation and agility are lived. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills further and be part of an international team.

For this, we are looking for you as our Working Student System Administration (all genders).

Your mission in detail:

  • As our Working Student System Administration, you are the contact person for all hardware and software problems and support the Helpling team with questions regarding the IT infrastructure in our Berlin office.

  • You support the provisioning and maintenance of our Windows- and OSX-based environment and help provide your colleagues with high-speed, bugless equipment.

  • You help manage our local networks and support troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation.

  • You bring your own ideas to improve existing workflows through customized automation.

  • You help ward off cyber attacks, create backups, and contribute to our overall IT security.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

A vocational training or degree is not the most important thing to us. We value your experience and are therefore looking for practically-versed, plug-and-play heroes with versatile IT knowledge who are currently enrolled at a university.

  • You are familiar with help desk user support, Google Workspace, setting up VLAN and VPN, as well as Windows and OSX systems, and ideally, you even bring first knowledge of a programming language.

  • You are reliable, motivated, and effortlessly juggle multiple inquiries at the same time.

  • You live in Berlin/Brandenburg and value our beautiful office in Berlin Mitte as your second 127.0.0.1

  • You are enrolled as a student throughout your time with us and can work up to 20 hours per week.

  • German language skills are a plus, very good English is a must.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

Flexibility: Flexible working & an office in Berlin Mitte for networking and socializing

Personal development: you work in a small team that gives you the opportunity to bring in your individual strengths and ideas and actively shape the future of Helpling.

Growth: define your individual growth path with the help of our feedback cycle, leadership workshops, book club, or lunch & learns

Vacation: up to 30 vacation days per year, depending on length of service. In addition, we give away up to 10 additional vacation days per year in cool campaigns, e.g., advent calendar or health challenges

Family & Career: we pay you 5 additional child sick days per year when your child needs you

Company Pension Scheme: with up to 20% employer contribution

Focus on the essentials, we'll take care of the rest: we offer you a discount for your own domestic help via Helpling.de


APPLY NOW

If this role sounds like you, then send us your application documents, including your availability and proof of current enrollment.

We would like to encourage you to apply even if you do not yet meet 100% of our expectations listed above. For us, your personality and motivation are just as important as your professional qualifications.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, migration history, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Westbridge Gruppe
description_html:
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen.
 
Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
 
Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d) für unser Team an den Standorten Hamburg oder Frankfurt.


Deine Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: 

  • Du verantwortest die strategische Gewinnung und Entwicklung von Kunden für unsere Nachhaltigkeitslösungen innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft.
  • Du identifizierst eigenverantwortlich neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und nutzt Dein bestehendes Netzwerk, um relevante Entscheidungsträger für Westbridge zu gewinnen.
  • Du vertrittst Westbridge auf Messen, Konferenzen und Branchenveranstaltungen und positionierst uns als führenden Partner für Nachhaltigkeit in der Immobilienwirtschaft.
  • Du analysierst die strategischen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Sustainability-Expertinnen und -Experten individuelle Lösungsansätze.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Vertriebsprozesse vom Erstkontakt über die Präsentation und Angebotserstellung bis zur Verhandlung und zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, verantwortest Deine Sales Pipeline und leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zu unseren Wachstums- und Umsatzzielen.


Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dabei ist uns besonders wichtig:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – idealerweise mit Bezug zur Immobilienwirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeit oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Mindestens sechs Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienwirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Beratungs- und Dienstleistungen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse rund um die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien, beispielsweise in den Bereichen ESG, Dekarbonisierung, Energieeffizienz oder nachhaltiges Immobilienmanagement.
  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung.
  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Verhandlungs- und Abschlussstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten auf Management- und Entscheider Ebene.
  • Eine selbstständige, unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


So arbeiten wir

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst dich aktiv einbringen. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen entwickelst du Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. 
 
Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, 30 Urlaubstage, freie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester, betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie Benefits wie Deutschlandticket, Edenred City oder Urban Sports Club, Firmenrad-Leasing und weitere Extras.


Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind. 
 
Bewirb dich einfach über unsere Karriereseite. Bei Fragen kannst du uns auch an Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tanso
description_html:
Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.


Why Tanso?

  • Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.
  • Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.
  • Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.
  • Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.
  • AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.
  • Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.


Your role

To take real ownership of what you build and take own end-to-end feature responsibility, we are looking for a Software Engineer (f/m/x). 

As a Software Engineer (m/f/x)  you will work on meaningful customer-facing problems within one of our platform modules and collaborate closely with product, design, customer success, and other engineers.

At Tanso, engineers are responsible understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, shaping the solution, making technical trade-offs, shipping to production, and iterating based on what we learn. We care less about following a predefined playbook and more about making good decisions, moving with purpose, and building software that creates tangible value for our customers.


Key responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing features from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Turn ambiguous requirements and user needs into pragmatic, maintainable solutions. Challenge assumptions and help decide what is worth building
  • Collaborate closely with product designers and customer success to understand user needs and shape effective solutions.
  • Contribute to the quality of our codebase, engineering practices, and developer experience.


Your profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software in Typescript.
  • Strong full-stack and product thinking, understanding systems end-to-end.
  • First experience with backend development, ideally with PostgreSQL and Azure.
  • Clear, precise communicator in English. 
  • Self-driven problem solver with strong ownership and execution mindset.
Nice to have
  • German language skills. 


What we offer

  • A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. 
  • Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. 
  • A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. 
  • Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. 
  • Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. 
  • Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. 


Our team

We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.

Tätigkeitsbereich

Du verantwortest die Akquise institutioneller Kunden und Mandate mit Schwerpunkt Brown-to-Green im Bereich Residential. Dies beinhaltet Partnerschaften und Asset Management Mandate für die Transformation bestehender Portfolios, als auch Einwerbung institutionellen Eigenkapitals für unsere Immobilienstrategien – von Club Deals und Separate Accounts über Joint Ventures bis hin zu Fondsvehikeln. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Investoren, führst Gespräche eigenständig bis zum Abschluss und baust die Partner- und Kapitalseite unserer Plattform systematisch aus.


Dabei handelt es sich um keine reine Vertriebsrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Transaktion, Asset Management und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übersetzt zwischen den Erwartungen der Investoren und operativer Realität.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Versorgungswerken, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen, Sparkassen, Stiftungen, Family Offices und Dachfonds

  • Eigenständige Ansprache, Qualifizierung und Betreuung von Investoren über den gesamten Zyklus – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Investorenunterlagen: Teaser, Pitch Decks, Track-Record-Darstellungen, Investment Memoranda

  • Steuerung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen auf Investorenseite, inklusive Koordination von RfPs, DDQs und Datenraumanfragen

  • Verhandlung kommerzieller Eckpunkte (Fee-Strukturen, Co-Investment, Governance, Reporting-Anforderungen) in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Kontinuierliche Marktbeobachtung hinsichtlich: Allokationsverhalten, Wettbewerbsvehikel sowie regulatorische Entwicklungen (Solvency II, AnlV, KAGB)

  • Pflege der Investoren-Pipeline im CRM, belastbares Reporting an die Geschäftsführung

  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Branchenveranstaltungen (Expo Real, MIPIM, Fachkonferenzen)


Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5–8 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Capital Raising, Investor Relations oder im institutionellen Vertrieb – zwingend mit klarem Immobilienbezug 

  • Belastbares, aktives Netzwerk zu deutschen institutionellen Investoren sowie nachweisbare eigene Abschlüsse

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Immobilien-Kennzahlen und Strukturen (u.a IRR, Equity Multiple, Cash-on-Cash, Wasserfall, Leverage, Asset-Deal vs. Share-Deal) 

  • Fundierte Kenntnis der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen deutscher institutioneller Anleger 

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 

  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands

  • Wünschenswert: 

    • Erfahrung mit Value-Add- oder opportunistischen Strategien, nicht nur Core wäre wünschenswert

    • Vorerfahrung auf Investorenseite (z. B. Kapitalanlage, Immobilienreferate)

    • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen LPs oder Luxemburger Strukturen

    • Bestehende Beziehungen zu Platzierungsberatern und Consultants


Unsere Benefits, wir schaffen

  • Raum für Erholung: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Der 24. und 31. Dezember sind zusätzlich arbeitsfrei. Für besondere Ereignisse (wie Umzug) bekommst du weiteren Sonderurlaub.
  • Raum für Mobilität: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket und unterstützen dein JobRad, so kommst du nachhaltig und flexibel zur Arbeit.
  • Raum für Absicherung: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sorgen wir dafür, dass du langfristig gut abgesichert in die Zukunft blickst.
  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Meinung zählt! Wir fördern kreative Impulse und laden dich ein, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Reneo mitzuwirken.
  • Raum für Gesundheit & Lifestyle: Du hast die Wahl zwischen unseren Sportangeboten (z. B. Urban Sports Club) oder erhältst Lunch-Gutscheine für deine Mittagspause.
  • Raum für Gemeinschaft: Regelmäßige Frühstücke, Team-Aktivitäten und unsere Sommer- sowie Weihnachtsfeier bringen alle zusammen.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ecoplanet Green Operations Gmbh
description_html:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Ecoplanet Green Operations Gmbh
description_html:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
  • Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders.
  • We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here
  • Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow.
  • Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again
  • Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one
  • Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads
  • You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind
  • You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after
  • Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself
  • You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call
  • You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand
Nice to have
  • Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain.
  • Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked).
Not required
  • Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something.
  • A “Head of” title already. We look at what you have done, not what it was called.


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)

description_html:
What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

  • Hands-on data science experience. You do not need a research background. You do need to have built and evaluated models yourself: enough to tell a real anomaly from noise, to judge when a finding is solid enough to put in front of a paying customer, and to know what a pipeline owes a model running in production

  • Solid with Python and SQL and cloud data infrastructure. You have designed and run pipelines, APIs and workflows in production

  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings

  • You think end to end before you go deep. When you hit a hard problem, the first instinct we want is “can a change somewhere else in the chain make this easy?” rather than heading straight into solving the hard version. A company our size cannot afford clever answers to problems that did not need solving

  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware

  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines

  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like TypeScript or Kotlin

  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Close collaboration with our Product team
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system


The Application

We don't do long forms. We don't do generic cover letters. Send us your CV and surprise us.

title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kolibrigames
description_html:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.

Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.

You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.

If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.


Responsibilities
  • Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on
  • Drive third-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands
  • Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument
  • Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows
  • Investigate open-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements

    • Required skills
  • (Ideally 5+ years of professional) Software development experience in C# and Unity3D. Experience in non-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply
  • You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar
  • Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions
  • Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable
  • Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders
  • Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec
  • A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack

    • Desirable skills
  • Experience debugging below the C# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile
  • Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar
  • Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask
  • A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps
  • Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results
  • Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs.
    • Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

    We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

    Your Benefits – We’re game to support you

    Competitive Salary - We believe that top performers should receive top payment
    Learning Budget - We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes
    Flexible Working Hours and Home Office – We believe in a good work-life balance
    Equipment - State-of-the-art technical equipment, including laptops and phones, which may also be used in your free time
    Kolicard - We offer you a monthly flexible budget of 50 euros that you can use for a gym membership, transportation, shopping etc.
    Mobility budget - We offer a monthly budget that will make your commuting to work easier
    Relocation - Relocation support to help you move to Berlin
    Pension - Opportunity to save for your pension tax-free

    Bonus Level – We love to have a good time, too

    Food and Drinks - Fresh fruits to keep you healthy and fresh coffee to keep you alert. We also have a fully stocked fridge with Smoothies, Coke, Club Mate, beer etc
    Parties and Team Events - Apart from our regular parties, BBQs and movie nights we also have a team event budget you can use to buy games or sports equipment to make working here even more fun
    Company Holidays - Every year we go on an amazing company holiday to relax and bond as a team
    Friday Celebrations - Company-provided dinner and drinks on Friday afternoons

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Researchgate
description_html:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.
